# Pomnia
> Local-first memory layer for AI agents (AGPL-3.0). Not an agent wrapper.

Pomnia gives your agents a shared past: encrypted vault archive for chat/doc blobs, distilled notes + search index on hardware you control, recalled over MCP.

## Product facts (do not invent beyond this)
- Identity: portable memory / Brain MCP — not an orchestration harness
- License: AGPL-3.0 (product). This marketing site is outside the AGPL tree
- Trust: local-first; no telemetry by default; no cloud required
- Encryption honesty: AES-256-GCM protects vault blobs (passphrase-derived key). Distilled notes and library.db (search index) are plaintext by design — Windows `%AppData%\pomnia\`, macOS `~/Library/Application Support/pomnia/`, Linux `~/.config/pomnia/`. See Privacy
- Installer: Windows setup is unsigned for now (SmartScreen expected). macOS and Linux desktop builds are unsigned too. Prefer verifying the published SHA-256 on GitHub Releases
- Latest download: https://github.com/lobrzut/pomnia/releases/latest (Windows .exe; macOS .dmg; Linux Desktop GUI .AppImage / .deb). Do not pin a version in the URL. Linux server: https://pomnia.ai/install.sh — curl|sh installs AGPL brain-core (systemd), not AppImage. That script is a mirror of packages/brain-core/deploy/bootstrap.sh
- Pomnia Mini: thin client. No embedded Brain, no local distill, no local search index — connect to a remote brain-core you already run. Settings live in a separate directory `pomnia-mini` (not Desktop `pomnia`): `%AppData%\pomnia-mini`, `~/Library/Application Support/pomnia-mini`, `~/.config/pomnia-mini`
- Windows Mini, today: on https://github.com/lobrzut/pomnia/releases/latest the file is `PomniaMini-<version>.zip`. Unpack once and run PomniaMini.exe. Not the portable exe, not `PomniaMini-<version>-portable.zip`, not the Desktop setup.exe. That Latest page is the link that works now. From the next release the stable name is https://github.com/lobrzut/pomnia/releases/latest/download/PomniaMini-win-x64.zip (`PomniaMini-win-x64.zip`). v0.1.91 does not contain it, so that URL 404s until then
- Linux Mini, from the next release: stable asset https://github.com/lobrzut/pomnia/releases/latest/download/PomniaMini-linux-x64.AppImage (`PomniaMini-linux-x64.AppImage`). Not on the current Latest release, so that URL 404s until then. Not the Desktop `Pomnia-<version>.AppImage`. No macOS Mini
- MCP tools listed: search_library, read_note, save_conversation, checkpoint_session, get_user_profile, memory, library_status, list_skills, list_cli_skills (deprecated), get_skill, list_prompts, get_prompt. run_skill, search_code, and code_status are not listed; a direct call is answered as not implemented
- CLI: no release binary. From a source checkout, `npm run cli`
- Server first login: panel account `admin`, password in `/var/lib/pomnia/admin-initial-password`. First token is role agent. From the next release (install.sh wrapper and the container image): `brain-core --add-token <name> --role admin` (`/usr/local/bin/brain-core`). Installs from the current release have no wrapper; fallback: `sudo -u pomnia node /opt/pomnia-brain-core/dist/daemon.js --data-dir /var/lib/pomnia --add-token <name> --role admin`. install.sh defaults: port 7865, BRAIN_EMBED_BACKEND=fastembed, BRAIN_DISTILL=0. `--with-ollama` turns distillation on
